newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daishowa, Marubeni to mull paper plant in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Daishowa, Marubeni to mull paper plant in Canada.

text.p: A joint venture between Daishowa Paper Manufacturing Co Ltd and Marubeni Corp will start studying construction of a paper plant in Canada, Marubeni said on Friday.
The investment in the project could total 72 billion yen, the trade house said in a statement.
Vancouver-based Daishowa-Marubeni International Ltd will start studying construction of a new plant to produce pulp and lightweight coated paper in Alberta, Marubeni said.
The plant would produce 250,000 to 350,000 tonnes of lightweight coated paper a year, it said. Operations of the plant would start in October 2001.
A decision on the project will be made by about the end of 1998, it added.
The joint venture already makes pulp at two plants in Canada.
